extDescription.message: Shows your remaining Claude.ai usage as a toolbar badge. Unofficial, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's add-on manager

loading.description: Placeholder shown in the popup while usage data is loading

noData.description: Shown when there is no usage data to display

refreshNow.description: Label of the manual refresh button

refreshing.description: Label of the manual refresh button while a refresh is in progress

toggleIntervalLabel.message: Badge rotation interval (Session ⇄ Reset ⇄ Week), in seconds:
toggleIntervalLabel.description: Label for the badge rotation interval input

seconds.description: Unit label next to the interval inputs

activeBadgeStepsLabel.description: Label above the badge step checkboxes

stepSession.description: Checkbox label for the session percentage badge step

stepSessionReset.description: Checkbox label for the session reset countdown badge step

stepWeek.description: Checkbox label for the weekly percentage badge step

refreshIntervalLabel.description: Label for the data refresh interval input

orgIdLabel.message: Organization ID (from the usage API URL):
orgIdLabel.description: Label for the organization ID input

orgIdPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the organization ID input

show.description: Button label to reveal the organization ID

hide.description: Button label to hide the organization ID

hintText.message: Green = Session, Yellow = Reset countdown, Blue = Week. Changes apply instantly.
hintText.description: Hint text below the settings explaining the badge colors

disclaimer.message: Unofficial add-on. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic or Claude.
disclaimer.description: Disclaimer shown at the bottom of the popup

unknown.description: Fallback text when a reset time is unavailable

updatedAt.description: Shows the timestamp of the last data update

limitReset.description: Shows the reset time of a usage limit

savedToggleInterval.description: Status message after saving the badge rotation interval

savedRefreshInterval.description: Status message after saving the data refresh interval

savedOrgId.description: Status message after saving the organization ID

clearedOrgId.description: Status message after clearing the organization ID

saved.description: Generic status message after saving a setting

tooltipStepSession.description: Tooltip: description of the session percentage badge step

tooltipStepSessionReset.description: Tooltip: description of the session reset countdown badge step

tooltipStepWeek.description: Tooltip: description of the weekly percentage badge step

tooltipNoSteps.description: Tooltip: shown when no badge steps are enabled

tooltipTitle.message: Claude Usage – badge rotates every $SECONDS$s between: $STEPS$. Data refreshed every $REFRESH$s (as of $STAMP$)
tooltipTitle.description: Tooltip title summarizing the badge rotation and refresh settings

tooltipLine.description: Tooltip line describing a single usage limit

noOrgIdTitle.message: Claude Usage: no organization ID set (enter it in the popup under settings)
noOrgIdTitle.description: Tooltip shown when no organization ID is configured

pollFailedTitle.message: Claude Usage: refresh failed (not logged in, or the API response changed)
pollFailedTitle.description: Tooltip shown when polling the usage API fails
